evidence_binding_contract.normative_invariant: REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_TOKEN != EVIDENCE_SATISFACTION. evidence_binding_contract.purpose: Universal evidence-admissibility and binding contract for required support. A required-evidence name/token is only a requirement identifier; it is never evidence satisfaction by itself.

requirement_satisfaction_derivation.ABSENT: No identifiable candidate evidence binding exists for the applicable required requirement.
requirement_satisfaction_derivation.CONFLICT_OR_STALE: Use existing conflict/staleness/fail-closed semantics when candidate admissible evidence materially conflicts or is stale for the consuming requirement.
requirement_satisfaction_derivation.PARTIAL_OR_NOT_PROVEN: A candidate binding exists but authority, scope, proof capability, validity/freshness, required identity, or lineage cannot be sufficiently established; use existing PARTIAL/NOT_PROVEN semantics appropriate to the consuming contract.
requirement_satisfaction_derivation.SATISFIED: At least one admissible binding for the exact requirement passes every applicable binding_validation_dimension and proves the required proposition within the consuming scope; when multiple mandatory evidence items exist, each is evaluated independently.
requirement_satisfaction_derivation.input: One applicable required-evidence requirement plus candidate evidence bindings.
requirement_satisfaction_derivation.token_presence_rule: Presence of the requirement token in context, Rulebook, prompt, model output, or a synthetic record does not count as a candidate evidence instance.

support_sufficiency_integration.dependency_scope: Failure or uncertainty propagates only through explicit required dependencies; unrelated decision units retain their independently supported assurance.

upstream_closure_contract.indirect_cycle_forbidden: Any dependency cycle such as RULE_A -> RULE_B -> RULE_C -> RULE_A invalidates derived closure evidence for the affected chain.

normative_clauses: برای هر مبلغ ریالی که طبق Rule مربوطه به Toman تبدیل می‌شود، فرمول تبدیل:
`Toman = ceil(Rial / 10)`
است.
مثال برای یک مبلغ منفرد:
برای **Composite Products**، Business Owner در `v1.2.0` Commercial Arithmetic Policy زیر را صریحاً تصویب کرده است:
`policy_id = COMPOSITE_ROUNDING_SUM_RIAL_THEN_CEIL_V1`
همه Component Source Prices ابتدا در صورت نیاز به Internal Rial exact Normalize می‌شوند.
همه Component Rial amounts با Integer/Decimal exact جمع می‌شوند.
فقط Total نهایی Composite یک‌بار با `ceil(total_rial / 10)` به Toman تبدیل می‌شود.
Component-level Rial-to-Toman Ceiling قبل از Summation ممنوع است.
Binary Floating Point در این محاسبات ممنوع است.
بنابراین برای Composite:
`Final Toman = ceil(sum(component_rial_i) / 10)`
و این رفتار در `PRC-008` و `PRC-009` برای خانواده‌های Composite فعلی تخصصی می‌شود.
